definitions.explanation: A person with exceptional skill or ability; also used as a modifier meaning 'highly skilled.'

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{凄腕|すごうで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧だ。
{凄腕|すごうで}⟦シェフ→シェフ：05062_shefu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: To enjoy the cuisine of a highly skilled chef.

examples.japanese: {凄腕|すごうで}ハッカー⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{狙|ねら}われた→狙う：00313_nerau⟧。
examples.english: I was targeted by an expert hacker.

notes:
FORMS:
{凄|すご}い (amazing) + ⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧ (arm, skill) → amazing skill = expert

USAGE:
Often used as a modifier before occupation nouns:
- {凄腕|すごうで}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧ - expert lawyer
- {凄腕|すごうで}⟦シェフ→シェフ：05062_shefu⟧ - master chef
- {凄腕|すごうで}ハッカー - skilled hacker
- {凄腕|すごうで}⟦{営業|えいぎょう}マン→営業マン：08749_eigyouman⟧ - ace salesperson
{凄腕|すごうで} has a slightly informal, admiring tone. It suggests someone whose skills are impressive or even intimidating. Often used in media and casual speech.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{腕前|うでまえ}→腕前：07299_udemae⟧ - skill, ability
- ⟦{敏腕|びんわん}→敏腕：07301_binwan⟧ - capable, competent (more formal)
- ⟦{達人|たつじん}→達人：14378_tatsujin⟧ - master, expert
